headline: Singapore Core Inflation Eases to 1.5% in October on Slower Services Price Growth
summary: Singapore's core inflation rate slowed to 1.5% year-on-year in October, down from the prior month as services inflation moderated. Retail goods and other commodities recorded minor price pickups during the period.
why: Core inflation is the primary economic metric tracked by the Monetary Authority of Singapore to set monetary policy parameters.

impacts.name: Singapore Dollar
impacts.why: Easing inflation provides flexibility for the central bank regarding its exchange rate band settings.
